description_en: Closes a secure tunnel that is in the Open state after the tunnel is created and used
description_zh: 安全隧道在创建并使用完毕后，可以关闭状态为已打开的安全隧道
kebab_example: aliyun iot close-device-tunnel --tunnel-id d4098041-a560-000 --iot-instance-id iot-000-v6000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloseDeviceTunnel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secure tunnel that you want to close
parameters.name: tunnel_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
